subject: MSA + Order Form: scheduling evidence handoff for on-prem deployment
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Claire Park <claire.park@soteria-sys.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-29T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: MSA + Order Form: scheduling evidence handoff for on-prem deployment

Hi Claire,

Thanks again for the call yesterday. Per our discussion I wanted to get ahead on scheduling the evidence-hand-off session for the on-prem (customer-managed) deployment in your SOC/IT environment. To keep things actionable, here's what we suggest: 

- A two-hour runbook review session (Redwood + Soteria security + your platform ops) to walk through: operator access model, snapshot/backup chain of custody, and the evidence artifacts you requested.
- Deliverables from our side ahead of the call: an itemized evidence checklist, an accountability matrix, and an initial redline to the MSA exhibits for deployment scope.
- Proposed slots: Tue Sep 7 (10:00–12:00 PT) or Thu Sep 9 (13:00–15:00 PT).

Questions for you before we lock the session:
1) Do you want the session recorded for your audit team (we can provide a secure recording link and retention details)?
2) For operator/admin access, which option in the MSA draft are you leaning to: (a) customer-managed operators with read-only vendor support vs (b) vendor-maintained operator account with audited access?
3) Any additional evidence artifacts beyond the checklist we should include (e.g., HSM attestation, full KV access logs)?

I've attached the preliminary evidence_checklist.xlsx and the draft_msa_redlines.docx for your legal team to review. Lauren (legal) and Aditya (AE) are cc'd — they'll join the session.

Best,
Mateo Alvarez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
mateo.alvarez@redwood.com
[Attachment: evidence_checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet)]
[Attachment: draft_msa_redlines.docx (doc)]

From: Claire Park <claire.park@soteria-sys.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Soteria Legal <legal@soteria-sys.com>
Date: 2026-08-29T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MSA + Order Form: scheduling evidence handoff for on-prem deployment

Thanks Mateo — appreciate the clear plan. A few quick points from Soteria Legal / Security: 

- Recording: OK to record the session provided the recording is stored in a mutually agreed secure location and access is restricted to named audit reviewers. Please include the proposed retention window in the invite.
- Operator model: our security team prefers (a) customer-managed operators with vendor access only through audited jump sessions. If you can show the runbook steps for the jump/approval flow that will help.
- Additional artifacts: we will want a snapshot proof-of-possession (hash + signed attestation) and a brief description of your key rotation/retention policy. HSM attestation would be nice-to-have but not mandatory for this phase.

On scheduling: Tue Sep 7 10:00–12:00 PT works for our security folks. Can you confirm and send a calendar invite with an agenda and the link to the secure recording location? Also ask your legal lead to review the draft_msa_redlines.docx and highlight any clauses that we should expect to see in final exhibits (operator access / data custody sections).

Clare (Soteria Legal) will be the day-of point.

Claire Park
Head of InfoSec Programs, Soteria Systems
claire.park@soteria-sys.com
[Attachment: Soteria_Audit_Rules_v2.pdf (pdf)]

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-29T14:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MSA + Order Form: scheduling evidence handoff for on-prem deployment

Looping in ops detail so we deliver clean artifacts. Notes / action items for the runbook: 

- I'll own the snapshot proof-of-possession: we'll provide a signed SHA256 hash of the image plus a notarized timestamp from our signing service. That will be attached as a PDF provenance bundle.
- For the jump session flow: draft run-level steps below (we'll expand in the session):
  1) Customer creates ephemeral operator account scoped to readonly/support for troubleshooting.
  2) Vendor requests access through the customer's ticketing system; request generates time-limited token.
  3) Token is consumed and all commands logged to a write-once audit stream; logs exported as read-only artifacts.
- Key rotation: we'll include an excerpt of our KMS key rotation policy and a sample Key ID rotation table for the last 12 months.

Attachments I'll prepare and upload to the secure folder before EOD Sep 3: svc_accountability_matrix.pdf, snapshot_provenance_bundle.pdf, key_rotation_summary.pdf.

Let me know if we should prepare any demo artifacts (short screen-share-only walkthrough) in addition to the documents — I recommend a 10–15 minute demo at the start of the runbook session to show the jump flow.

—Marcus
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com
[Attachment: svc_accountability_matrix.pdf (pdf)]

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Claire Park <claire.park@soteria-sys.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-31T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MSA + Order Form: scheduling evidence handoff for on-prem deployment

Claire — confirmed for Tue Sep 7 10:00–12:00 PT. Calendar invite sent with agenda and a secure recording link (retention 90 days; access limited to named audit reviewers).

Per Marcus, we'll ship the following prior to the session (expected delivery by EOD Sep 3):
- svc_accountability_matrix.pdf (responsibilities and contact points)
- snapshot_provenance_bundle.pdf (signed hash + timestamp)
- key_rotation_summary.pdf (KMS rotation snapshot)

I've also attached an updated evidence_checklist.xlsx that incorporates Claire's asks and a short cover note in draft_msa_redlines.docx calling out the operator-access exhibit language we propose (customer-managed operators + audited jump flow).

Next steps for legal: Lauren — can you and Aditya review the attached draft_msa_redlines.docx and highlight any clauses we should expect Soteria to push back on before the session? If we can identify 2–3 negotiation points ahead of time we can keep the runbook call focused on ops evidence rather than legal debate.

Claire, please let us know the names/emails of the audit reviewers who should get the recording and any specific redaction requirements.

Thanks — looking forward to the session.

Best,
Mateo Alvarez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
mateo.alvarez@redwood.com
[Attachment: evidence_checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet)]
[Attachment: draft_msa_redlines.docx (doc)]
